flows.name: Home screen and difficulty selection

steps.action: Launch the app
steps.expected: Home screen visible with MathKids title, stat cards, difficulty picker, and play button

steps.action: Verify stat cards show streak, solved, and best score
steps.expected: Three stat cards visible with icons and values

steps.action: Tap Medium difficulty
steps.expected: Medium difficulty button becomes highlighted

steps.action: Tap Hard difficulty
steps.expected: Hard difficulty button becomes highlighted

flows.notes: All elements well-spaced, gradient title looks great, difficulty buttons highlight correctly with color coding

flows.name: Game play flow

steps.action: Tap Play button from home
steps.expected: Game screen appears with problem, timer bar, score, and number pad

steps.action: Enter a number on the number pad
steps.expected: Number appears in answer field

steps.action: Submit answer
steps.expected: Answer field clears, new problem appears

steps.action: Verify timer bar is counting down
steps.expected: Timer bar shrinks, timer label shows remaining seconds

flows.notes: Problem text large and clear (64pt), number pad has good tap targets, timer bar with gradient animation, score and timer in header

flows.name: Results screen after game ends

steps.action: Complete a game (wait for timer)
steps.expected: Results screen appears with score, accuracy, streak, and buttons

steps.action: Verify score, accuracy, and streak stats
steps.expected: Stats match game performance

steps.action: Tap Play Again
steps.expected: New game starts

flows.notes: Emoji header, animated score count-up, NEW BEST SCORE badge, stat cards, Play Again and Home buttons all work correctly

flows.name: Stats and progress screen

steps.action: Tap Stats tab
steps.expected: Stats screen with streak flame, lifetime stats, difficulty breakdown, weekly activity

steps.action: Verify lifetime stats section
steps.expected: Shows problems solved, accuracy, best streak, best score

flows.notes: Progress title, flame streak section, 2x2 lifetime stats grid, games by difficulty row, all scrollable

flows.name: Tab navigation and game flow navigation

steps.action: Switch between Play and Stats tabs
steps.expected: Tab bar works, correct screens shown

steps.action: Play tab shows home, start game navigates correctly
steps.expected: Full navigation flow works

flows.notes: Tab switching works, navigation Home->Game->Results->Home verified

flows.name: Dark mode pass

steps.action: Switch to dark mode and view home screen
steps.expected: All text readable, colors adapt, no contrast issues

steps.action: View game screen in dark mode
steps.expected: Problem text, number pad, timer all visible in dark mode

steps.action: View stats screen in dark mode
steps.expected: Stats cards, streak section all readable

flows.notes: All screens adapt beautifully to dark mode. Gradients, tinted backgrounds, and semantic colors all work correctly.

flows.name: Soak test - extended usage

steps.action: Play 2 games in a row (easy, medium)
steps.expected: Stats accumulate correctly, no crashes, navigation works

steps.action: Check stats after multiple games
steps.expected: Total solved, games played, per-difficulty counts all correct

steps.action: Switch tabs rapidly between Play and Stats
steps.expected: No stale data, no crashes, stats refresh on appear

flows.notes: After 2 games: 11 solved, 27% accuracy, best score 25, Easy:2 Medium:1. Stats consistent across home and stats screens. Rapid tab switching caused no issues.
